category_title: Students in an inclusive urban classroom exhibiting high-frequency disruptive behaviors and low academic engagement
scenario_title: Navigating the classroom to access supplies and computers
minimal_context: The student is navigating the classroom to retrieve supplies from the teacher's desk and access the computer area for independent work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent work. Please walk to my desk to get your supplies and reading books, or go to the computer area.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves seat and walks through the undefined pathway, pushing another student) Move out of my way!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please walk quietly and get your materials.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops at the computers facing the classroom, ignoring the teacher's direction) Hey, look at what is on this screen!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to get your supplies from my desk and go to your seat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks to the congested teacher's desk, hits another student reaching for the same supplies, and throws a marker across the room) Back off, I was here first! I'm not doing this!
